title: Create keys in bulk: after Create
summary: The New license drawer after Create 200 keys: the one-time CSV before and after its download, the confirmation when closing before any download, and a partial result (120 of 200 created) with Retry.
compare: A board of drawers (.board.cols-2.wide-3), each in a stage with the drawer's own edges.

Done: a success callout '200 keys created in Mixer bundle · Oct 2026' / 'Each is a floating Standard license.'; the CSV as a tinted file row (djdl-mixer-bundle-oct-2026.csv, 200 rows, 18 KB) with Download CSV, the only primary; 'Download now: this is the only time the keys can be shown.'; Open batch and Close.
Downloaded: the file row says 'Downloaded at 10:42' with Download again (secondary); 'Download again works until you close this.'; Done closes without asking.
Closing early: 'Close without the CSV?' over the drawer: 'The 200 keys can’t be shown again, so nobody could use them.'; Close without keys (danger outline) and Download CSV (primary).
Partial result: a warning 'Created 120 of 200 keys' / 'Polaris Key stopped answering. Retry makes the other 80 in the same batch, with their own CSV.' with Retry; the CSV with 120 rows.

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: kit drawers on board stages, callouts and item rows; 0 screen spacing.

findings.issue: 12 spacing declarations and custom done marks, file boxes and a stage scrim.
findings.resolution: Kit only: .board-stage with .drawer and .overlay.center, .callout tones, .card.tint with .item-row, .drawer-foot .start.

findings.issue: Each drawer repeated the batch and tier in a fact list under the title; the partial result had two warnings.
findings.resolution: The callout names the batch once; one warning carries Retry.

findings.issue: The count and the once-only warning appeared two or three times.
findings.resolution: Banner says '200 keys created'; the file card is the name and size; the once-only line sits once, muted, above the card, and again in the close-early dialog; the file name wraps at its hyphens (.wrap-name); on phone the CSV card is neutral (.neutral-phone).
